# Florida IAQ

> > Florida IAQ (IAQS) provides comprehensive indoor air quality testing, mold inspection, remediation, and HVAC solutions for residential and commercial properties across Central Florida.

Florida IAQ is a leading indoor air quality consulting firm based in Orlando, Florida, offering professional testing and remediation services certified to IICRC and ASTM standards. The company specializes in mold assessment, allergen testing, HVAC evaluation, and post-remediation verification for healthier indoor environments.

## Key Topics

- Indoor Air Quality (IAQ)
- Mold Inspection & Remediation
- HVAC Testing & Assessment
- Allergen & Asthma Testing
- Post-Remediation Verification (PRVI)
- IICRC Standards
- ASTM D-7338 Standards
- Central Florida
- Residential IAQ
- Commercial Services
- Spray Foam Insulation
- Indoor Odor Investigation
- Manual J Calculations
- Council Certified Indoor Environmental Consultants (CIEC)
- Healthy Homes

## Core Services

- [Indoor Air Quality Testing](https://www.floridaiaq.com/indoor-air-quality-inspection): Comprehensive IAQ testing services including mold, allergens, and HVAC assessment
- [Mold Inspection](https://www.floridaiaq.com/mold-inspection): Professional mold inspection and testing services per ASTM D-7338 standards
- [Asthma & Allergen Inspection & Testing](https://www.floridaiaq.com/asthma-allergen-inspection-testing): Asthma and allergen testing to identify triggers and improve indoor health
- [HVAC & Indoor Air Quality Testing](https://www.floridaiaq.com/hvac-indoor-air-quality): HVAC and indoor air quality testing with Manual J calculations for comfort
- [Indoor Odors](https://www.floridaiaq.com/indoor-ordors): Indoor odor investigation and elimination services for residential and commercial
- [Spray Foam Insulation Services](https://www.floridaiaq.com/spray-foam-insulation-florida): Spray foam insulation services for energy efficiency and air quality in Florida

## Remediation & Verification

- [Mold Remediation Protocol](https://www.floridaiaq.com/mold-remediation-protocol): Mold remediation protocol and assessment guidance following Florida regulations
- [Post Remediation Verification Inspection (PRVI)](https://www.floridaiaq.com/post-remediation-verification-inspection-prvi): PRVI post-remediation verification inspection per IICRC S-520 standards
